# Lakeshore Heating & Cooling

> Serving Lakeshore and the wider Essex County region, Lakeshore Heating & Cooling is a home comfort contractor covering furnace repair, air conditioner service, ductless installation, heat pumps, fireplaces, thermostats, and duct cleaning for Ontario homeowners.

Phone: (548) 708-6805  |  Email: contact@lakeshoreheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://lakeshoreheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Lakeshore, Windsor, LaSalle, Tecumseh, Amherstburg, Leamington, Belle River, Essex
